changelog: Recommends the on-console Doctor relay to retrieve logs without editing config.ini.
Explains why binding ShadowMountPlus only to the console-specific LAN IP can break its loopback launcher.
Documents the direct LAN mode as an optional fallback and preserves the no-authentication warning.

privacy.downloads: Only the diagnostic knowledge-base JSON is downloaded after user confirmation.
privacy.uploads: No logs, reports, console IP addresses, or personal data are uploaded by the updater.
